smon pa myed pa'i phyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ma lags pa gzhan du yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /des ye shes de mngon par shes pa rnams kyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de mngon par shes pa rnams kyi phyi rol tu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de mngon par shes pa rnams kyi phyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de mngon par shes pa rnams ma lags pa gzhan du yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /des ye shes de ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi phyi rol tu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi phyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de ting nge 'dzin rnams ma lags pa gzhan du yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /des ye shes de gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi phyi rol tu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi phyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de gzungs kyi sgo rnams ma lags pa gzhan du yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /des ye shes de de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i phyi rol tu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i phyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ma lags pa gzhan du yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /des ye shes de myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi phyi rol tu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi phyi nang du yang dag par

rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de myi 'jigs pa rnams ma lags pa gzhan du yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /des ye shes de so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi phyi rol tu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi phyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ma lags pa gzhan du yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /des ye shes de snying rje chen po'i nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de snying rje chen po'i phyi rol tu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de snying rje chen po'i phyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de snying rje chen po ma lags pa gzhan du yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /des ye shes de sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi phyi rol tu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi phyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ma lags pa gzhan du yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /des ye shes de rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'i nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'i phyi rol tu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'i phyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ma lags pa gzhan du yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /des ye shes de lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i phyi rol tu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong /

ye shes de lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i phyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ma lags pa gzhan du yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /des ye shes de phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i phyi rol tu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i phyi dang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ma lags pa gzhan du yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /des ye shes de dgra bcom pa nyid kyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de dgra bcom pa nyid kyi phyi rol tu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de dgra bcom pa nyid kyi phyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de dgra bcom pa nyid ma lags pa gzhan du yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /des ye shes de rang byang chub kyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de rang byang chub kyi phyi rol tu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de rang byang chub kyi phyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de rang byang chub ma lags pa gzhan du yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /des ye shes de lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi phyi rol tu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi phyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ma lags pa gzhan du yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /des ye shes de rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi phyi rol tu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi phyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye

shes de rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma lags pa gzhan du yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /des ye shes de de bzhin nyid kyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de de bzhin nyid kyi phyi rol tu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de de bzhin nyid kyi phyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de de bzhin nyid ma lags pa gzhan du yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /des ye shes de ma nor ba de bzhin nyid kyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de ma nor ba de bzhin nyid kyi phyi rol tu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de ma nor ba de bzhin nyid kyi phyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de ma nor ba de bzhin nyid ma lags pa gzhan du yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /des ye shes de gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid kyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid kyi phyi rol tu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid kyi phyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid ma lags pa gzhan du yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /des ye shes de chos nyid kyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de chos nyid kyi phyi rol tu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de chos nyid kyi phyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de chos nyid ma lags pa gzhan du yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /des ye shes de chos kyi dbyings kyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de chos kyi dbyings kyi phyi rol tu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de chos kyi dbyings kyi phyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de chos kyi dbyings ma lags pa gzhan du yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /des ye shes de chos kyi gnas nyid kyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes

de chos kyi gnas nyid kyi phyi rol tu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de chos kyi gnas nyid kyi phyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de chos kyi gnas nyid ma lags pa gzhan du yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /des ye shes de chos skyon myed pa nyid kyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de chos skyon myed pa nyid kyi phyi rol tu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de chos skyon med pa nyid kyi phyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de chos skyon med pa nyid ma lags pa gzhan du yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /des ye shes de yang dag pa'i mtha'i nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de yang dag pa'i mtha'i phyi rol tu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de yang dag pa'i mtha'i phyi nang du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ye shes de yang dag pa'i mtha' ma lags pa gzhan du yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /rnam grangs 'di la kun tu rgyu ba phreng ba can mos par gyur te/ de ltar mos par gyur nas/ dad pa'i rjes su 'brang bas chos nyid tshad mar bgyis te chos thams cad myi dmyigs pa'i slad du/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes la zhugs par gyur te/ de de ltar mos par gyur nas des chos gang yang mtshan ma ma mchis pa dang / yid la bgyi ba ma mchis pa'i slad du yongs su bzung ba ma mchis te/ chos thams cad gzung du ma mchis/ gtang du ma ma mchis pa'i slad du yongs su gzung bar bgyi ba'am/ gtang bar bgyi ba de lta bu'i chos gang yang des ma dmyigs te/ chos thams cad la rlom sems ma mchis pa'i slad du de ni mya ngan las 'das pas kyang rlom sems su 'gyur ba ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar gang chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ gzugs yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /

'du shes yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / 'du byed yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ myig yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rna ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / sna yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lce yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lus yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / yid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ /gzugs yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / sgra yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / dri yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / ro yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / reg yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / /chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / /chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin

ba dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / /chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ sa'i khams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chu'i khams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / mye'i khams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rlung gi khams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / nam mkha'i khams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / /chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ ma rig pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / 'du byed yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / mying dang gzugs yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / skye mched drug yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / sred pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / len pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / srid pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / skye ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rga shi yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / /chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su mi 'dzin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / /chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ nang stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / phyi stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chen po stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / 'dus

byas stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / /chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ yang dag par spyod pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / /chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ yang dag par spong ba rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ dbang po rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ stobs rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang/ chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ bsam gtan rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ tshad myed pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos

thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ rnam par thar pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ mngon par shes pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ ting nge 'dzin rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu yangs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ snying rje chen po yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis

pa'i slad du/ dgra bcom pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ rang byang chub yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ de bzhin nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ ma nor ba de bzhin nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ chos nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ chos kyi dbyings yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ chos kyi gnas nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ chos skyon myed pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ yang dag pa'i mtha' yongs su myi 'dzin pa 'di ni/ pha rol ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po gsum pa/ 'on kyang smon lam yongs su ma rdzogs kyi bar du bar ma dor yongs su mya ngan las myi 'da' ste/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi yongs su ma rdzogs/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi yongs su ma rdzogs/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa

bzhi yongs su ma rdzogs/ dbang po lnga yongs su ma rdzogs/ stobs lnga yongs su ma rdzogs/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun yongs su ma rdzogs/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yongs su ma rdzogs/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi yongs su ma rdzogs/ bsam gtan bzhi yongs su ma rdzogs/ tshad myed pa bzhi yongs su ma rdzogs/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi yongs su ma rdzogs/ rnam par thar pa brgyad yongs su ma rdzogs/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yongs su ma rdzogs/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yongs su ma rdzogs/ mngon par shes pa rnams yongs su ma rdzogs/ ting nge 'dzin rnams yongs su ma rdzogs/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams yongs su ma rdzogs de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu yongs su ma rdzogs/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi yongs su ma rdzogs/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi yongs su ma rdzogs/ snying rje chen po yongs su ma rdzogs/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad yongs su ma rdzogs kyi bar du bar ma dor yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar smon lam rnams ni smon lam ma lags/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ma lags/ yang dag par spong ba rnams ni yang dag par spong ba ma lags/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ma lags/ dbang po rnams ni dbang po ma lags/ stobs rnams ni stobs ma lags/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ni byang chub kyi yan lag ma lags/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ni 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ma lags/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ni 'phags pa'i bden pa ma lags/ bsam gtan rnams ni bsam gtan ma lags/ tshad med pa rnams ni tshad med pa ma lags/

gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa ma lags/ rnam par thar pa rnams ni rnam par thar pa ma lags/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ni mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa ma lags/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa ma lags/ mngon par shes pa rnams ni mngon par shes pa ma lags/ ting nge 'dzin rnams ni ting nge 'dzin ma lags/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni gzungs kyi sgo ma lags/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs ma lags/ myi 'jigs pa rnams ni myi 'jigs pa ma lags/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ni/ so so yang dag par rig pa ma lags/ snying rje chen po ni/ snying rje chen po ma lags/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ma lags te/ de dag ni chos kyang ma lags/ chos ma lags pa yang ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ gzugs yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / 'du shes yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / 'du byed yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / /chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ myig yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rna ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / sna yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lce yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lus yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / yid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / /chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ gzugs yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / sgra yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / dri yongs su mi 'dzin pa dang / ro yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /

reg yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / /chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ myig gi rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / /chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ sa'i khams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chu'i khams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / mye'i khams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rlung gi khams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / nam mkha'i khams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / /chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ ma rig pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / 'du byed yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rnam par shes pa yongs su mi 'dzin pa dang / mying dang gzugs yongs su

myi 'dzin pa dang / skye mched drug yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / sred pa yongs su mi 'dzin pa dang / len pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / srid pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / skye ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rga shi yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / /chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / /chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ nang stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / phyi stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chen po stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / Rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / /chos thams

cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / dbang po rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / stobs rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / /chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / bsam gtan rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / tshad myed pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams yongs su mi 'dzin pa dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / /chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / snying rje chen po yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / /chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / dgra bcom pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rang byang chub yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid

yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / /chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ de bzhin nyid yongs su mi 'dzin pa dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos kyi dbyings yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos kyi gnas nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' yongs su myi 'dzin pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni gang gi/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni ci zhig /ci'i phyir na/ de la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya zhes yongs su brtag par bgyi ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gal te 'di ltar chos gang yod pa ma yin zhing myi dmyigs pa de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin nam zhes spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la myi spyod do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bus/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor chos gang rnams myed cing myi dmyigs pa yin/ /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa

nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir gzugs myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'du shes myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa myed cing myi dmyigs go/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid

dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ myig myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sna myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lce myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lus myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /yid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ gzugs myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sgra myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dri myed cing myi dmigs so/ /ro myed cing myi dmigs so/ /reg myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /chos myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang /

dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ myig gi rnam par shes pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ myig

gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba med cing myi dmyigs so/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ sa'i khams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /chu'i khams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ mye'i khams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rlung gi khams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /nam mkha'i khams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang /

myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ ma rig pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /mying dang gzugs myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /skye mched drug myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /reg pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sred pa myed cing mi dmyigs so/ /len pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /srid pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /skye ba myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rga shi myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid

dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dbang po rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /stobs rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams myed cing myi dmigs so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ bsam gtan rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshad myed pa rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa

nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pa myed cing myi dmigs so/ /mngon par shes pa rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /snying rje chen po myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dgra bcom pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rang byang chub myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma

myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ de bzhin nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /ma nor ba de bzhin nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /chos nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /chos kyi dbyings myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /chos kyi gnas nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /chos skyon myed pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'ang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'ang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'ang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dgra bcom pa'ang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rang sangs rgyas kyang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang dmigs su med pa'i phyir/ nang stong pa nyid myed cing myi

dmyigs so/ /phyi dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ phyi stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /phyi nang dmigs su myed pa'i phyir/ phyi nang stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /chen po stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ chen po stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ don dam pa stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su med pa'i phyir/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid dmigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid myed cing mi dmyigs so/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dmigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed

pa'i phyir/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gal te de ltar rtog cing sems pa dang / de ltar rtog cing sems pa'i tshe/ sems zhum pa myed cing yongs su zhum pa myed la/ myi 'jigs myi sngang skrag par myi 'gyur na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ma bral bar shes par bya'o/ /smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ma bral bar shes par bya/ rab 'byor kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzugs ni gzugs kyi rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /tshor ba ni tshor ba'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /'du shes ni 'du shes kyi rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin tu rab tu shes so/ /'du byed ni 'du byed kyi rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /rnam par shes pa ni rnam par shes pa'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ myig ni myig gi rang bzhin dang bral ba

ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /rna ba ni rna ba'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /sna ni sna'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /lce ni lce'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /lus ni lus kyi rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /yid ni yid kyi rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzugs ni gzugs kyi rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /sgra ni sgra'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /dri ni dri'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ ro ni ro'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes

de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /nam mkha'i khams ni nam mkha'i khams kyi rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams ni rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ ma rig pa ni ma rig pa'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /'du byed ni 'du byed kyi rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /rnam par shes pa ni rnam par shes pa'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /mying dang gzugs ni mying dang gzugs kyi rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /skye mched drug ni skye mched drug gi rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /reg pa ni reg pa'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /tshor
