ti'i bu/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa

nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ yang dag par spong ba rnams nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa rnams nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang /

'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ dbang po rnams nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ stobs rnams nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /

sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong

pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ bsam gtan rnams nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ tshad med pa rnams nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong

pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam par thar pa brgyad nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos

po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ mngon par shes pa rnams nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ ting nge 'dzin rnams nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa

nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang /

stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dusam byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ snying rje chen po nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa

stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /de la byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams med pa la mngon par zhen pas/ sredapa la mngon par zhen te/ de dag gis med pa/ yongs su brtags pas/ med pa la mngon par zhen cing / 'di lta ste/ chad pa dang / rtag pa'i mtha' gnyis la chags pas de dag mi shes mi mthong ste/ gang med pa'i chos de dag yongs su brtags nas/ ming dang gzugs la mngon par zhen pa de dag /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par zhen to/ /tshul khrims gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par zhen to/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par zhen to/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par zhen to/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par zhen to/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par zhen to/ /nang stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /phyi stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /chen po stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid

la mngon par zhen to/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /dor pa med pa stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /dngos po med pa stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams la mngon par zhen to/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /dbang po rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /stobs rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la mngon par zhen to/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /bsam gtan rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /tshad med pa rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /rnam par thar pa rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pa la mngon par zhen to/ /mngon par shes pa rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /mi 'jigs pa rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la

mngon par zhen to/ /snying rje chen po la mngon par zhen to/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la/ mngon par zhen to/ /de dag de ltar mngon par zhen pas/ yod pa ma yin pa'i chos rnams la yongs su rtog ste/ de dag mi shes mi mthong ngo / /ci mi shes mi mthong zhe na/ gzugs mi shes mi mthong ngo / /tshor ba mi shes mi mthong ngo / /'du shes myi shes mi mthong ngo / /'du byed mi shes mi mthong ngo / /rnam par shes pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /mig mi shes mi mthong ngo / /rna ba mi shes mi mthong ngo / /sna mi shes mi mthong ngo / /lce mi shes mi mthong ngo / /lus myi shes myi mthong ngo / /yid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /gzugs mi shes mi mthong ngo / /sgra mi shes mi mthong ngo / /dri mi shes mi mthong ngo / /ro mi shes mi mthong ngo / /reg mi shes mi mthong ngo / /chos mi shes mi mthong ngo / /myig gi rnam par shes pa myi shes myi mthong ngo / /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /sna'i rnam par shes pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /lce'i rnam par shes pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /lus kyi rnam par shes pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /yid kyi rnam par shes pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /mig gi 'dus te reg pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /sna'i 'dus te reg pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /lce'i 'dus te reg pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mi shes mi mthong ngo / /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mi shes mi mthong ngo / /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mi shes mi mthong ngo / /lce'i 'dus te rag pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mi shes mi mthong ngo / /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba

mi shes mi mthong ngo / /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mi shes mi mthong ngo / /sa'i khams mi shes mi mthong ngo / /chu'i khams mi shes mi mthong ngo / /me'i khams mi shes mi mthong ngo / /rlung gi khams mi shes mi mthong ngo / /nam mkha'i khams mi shes mi mthong ngo / /rnam par shes pa'i khams mi shes mi mthong ngo / /ma rig pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /'du byed mi shes mi mthong ngo / /rnam par shes pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /ming dang gzugs mi shes mi mthong ngo / /skye mched drug mi shes mi mthong ngo / reg pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /tshor ba mi shes mi mthong ngo / /sred pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /len pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /srid pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / skye ba mi shes mi mthong ngo / /rga shi mi shes mi mthong ngo / /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /nang stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /phyi stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /phyi nang stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /chen po stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /don dam pa stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /'dus byas stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /dor ba med pa stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /rang bzhin stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /chos thams cad stong pa nyid mi shes

mi mthong ngo / /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /dngos po med pa stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi mi shes mi mthong ngo / /yang dag par spong ba bzhi mi shes mi mthong ngo / /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi mi shes mi mthong ngo / /dbang po lnga mi shes mi mthong ngo / /stobs lnga mi shes mi mthong ngo / /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun mi shes mi mthong ngo / /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams mi shes mi mthong ngo / /bsam gtan rnams mi shes mi mthong ngo / /tshad med pa rnams mi shes mi mthong ngo / /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi mi shes mi mthong ngo / /rnam par thar pa brgyad mi shes mi mthong ngo / /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu mi shes mi mthong ngo / stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /mngon par shes pa rnams mi shes mi mthong ngo / /ting nge 'dzin rnams mi shes mi mthong ngo / /gzungs kyi sgo rnams mi shes mi mthong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu myi shes myi mthong ngo / /myi 'jigs pa bzhi myi shes myi mthong ngo / /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi myi shes myi mthong ngo / /snying rje chen po myi shes myi mthong ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams myi shes myi mthong ngo / /de ltar de dag ni byis pa zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'dong ba ste/ de dag 'byung ba ma yin no/ /gang nas 'byung ba ma yin zhe na/ 'dod pa'i khams nas 'byung ba ma yin no/ /gzugs kyi khams nas 'byung ba ma yin no/ /gzugs med pa'i khams nas

'byung ba ma yin no/ /nyan thos kyi sa nas 'byung ba ma yin no/ /rang sangs rgyas kyis nas 'byung ba ma yin no/ /de dag ni yid mi ches pa ste/ ji ltar yid mi ches zhe na/ gzugs gzugs kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /tshor ba tshor bas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /'du shes 'du shes kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /'du byed 'du byed kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rnam par shes pa rnam par shes pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /mig mig gis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rna ba rna bas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /sna snas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /lce lces stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ lus lus kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /yid yid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /gzugs gzugs kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /sgra sgras stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /dri dris stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /ro ros stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /reg reg gis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /chos chos kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /mig gi rnam par shes pa mig gi rnam par shes pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa rna ba'i rnam par shes pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa sna'i rnam par shes pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa lce'i rnam par shes pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa lus kyi rnam par shes pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa yid kyi rnam par shes pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /mig gi 'dus te reg pa mig gi 'dus te reg pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa rna ba'i 'dus te reg pas

stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa sna'i 'dus te reg pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa lce'i 'dus te reg pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa lus kyi 'dus te reg pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yid kyi 'dus te reg pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /sa'i khams sa'i khams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /chu'i khams chu'i khams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /me'i khams me'i khams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rlung gi khams rlung gi khams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /nam mkha'i khams nam mkha'i khams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams rnam par shes pa'i khams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /ma rig pa ma rig pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /'du byed 'du byed kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rnam par shes pa rnam par shes pas

stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /ming dang gzugs ming dang gzugs kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /skye mched drug skye mched drug gis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /reg pa reg pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /tshor ba tshor bas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /sred pa sred pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /len pa len pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /srid pa srid pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /skye ba skye bas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rga shi rga shis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /nang stong pa nyid nang stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /phyi stong pa nyid phyi stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid phyi nang stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /chen po stong pa nyid chen po stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid don dam pa stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /'dus ma byas stong

pa nyid 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dor ba med pa stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dngos po med pa stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /yang dag par spong ba bzhi yang dag par spong ba rnams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /dbang po lnga dbang po rnams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /stobs lnga stobs rnams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/

'phags pa'i bden pa rnams 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /bsam gtan rnams bsam gtan rnams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /tshad med pa rnams tshad med pa rnams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug par dgus stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /mngon par shes pa rnams mngon par shes pa rnams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams ting nge 'dzin rnams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcus stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /mi 'jigs pa bzhi mi 'jigs pa bzhis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi so so yang dag par rig pa bzhis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /snying rje chen po snying rje chen pos stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bus stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /

lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bus stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bus stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /dgra bcom pa nyid dgra bcom pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rang byang chub rang byang chub kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /de dag ni gnas pa ma yin pa ste/ ji ltar gnas pa ma yin zhe na/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa ma yin/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa ma yin/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa ma yin/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa ma yin/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa ma yin/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa ma yin/ nang stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ phyi stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ phyi nang stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ chen po stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ don dam pa stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ dngos po med pa stong pa nyid la

gnas pa ma yin/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la gnas pa ma yin/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams par gnas pa ma yin/ yang dag par spong ba rnams la gnas pa ma yin/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la gnas pa ma yin/ dbang po rnams la gnas pa ma yin/ stobs rnams la gnas pa ma yin/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la gnas pa ma yin/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la gnas pa ma yin/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la gnas pa ma yin/ bsam gtan rnams la gnas pa ma yin/ tshad med pa rnams la gnas pa ma yin/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la gnas pa ma yin/ rnam par thar pa brgyad la gnas pa ma yin/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la gnas pa ma yin/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa la gnas pa ma yin/ mngon par shes pa rnams la gnas pa ma yin/ ting nge 'dzin rnams la gnas pa ma yin/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams la gnas pa ma yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la gnas pa ma yin/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi la gnas pa ma yin/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la gnas pa ma yin/ byams pa chen po la gnas pa ma yin/ snying rje chen po la gnas pa ma yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la gnas pa ma yin no/ /de dag ni mngon par zhen pa yin te/ ji ltar mngon par zhen pa yin zhe na/ gzugs la mngon par zhen pa yin/ tshor ba la mngon par zhen pa yin/ 'du shes la mngon par zhen pa yin/ 'du byed la mngon par zhen pa yin/ rnam par shes pa la mngon par zhen pa

yin/ mig la mngon par zhen pa yin/ rna ba la mngon par zhen pa yin/ sna la mngon par zhen pa yin/ lce la mngon par zhen pa yin/ lus la mngon par zhen pa yin/ yid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ gzugs la mngon par zhen pa yin/ sgra la mngon par zhen pa yin/ dri la mngon par zhen pa yin/ ro la mngon par zhen pa yin/ reg la mngon par zhen pa yin/ chos la mngon par zhen pa yin/ mig gi khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ gzugs kyi khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ mig gi rnam par shes pa'i khams la/ mngon par zhen pa yin/ rna ba'i khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ sgra'i khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ sna'i khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ dri'i khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ sna'i rnam par shes pa'i khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ lce'i khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ ro'i khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ lce'i rnam par shes pa'i khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ lus kyi khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ reg bya'i khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ yid kyi khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ chos kyi khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ 'dod chags la mngon par zhen pa yin/ zhe sdang la mngon par zhen pa yin/ gti mug la mngon par zhen pa yin/ lta ba'i rnam pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ ma rig pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ 'du byed la mngon par zhen pa yin/ rnam par shes pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ ming dang gzugs la mngon par zhen pa yin/

skye mched drug la mngon par zhen pa yin/ reg pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ tshor ba la mngon par zhen pa yin/ sred pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ len pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ srid pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ skye ba la mngon par zhen pa yin/ rga shi la mngon par zhen pa yin/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ nang stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ phyi stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ phyi nang stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ chen po stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ don dam pa stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ dngos po med pa stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la mngon par zhen pa

yin/ yang dag par spong ba rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ dbang po rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ stobs rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ bsam gtan rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ tshad med pa rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ rnam par thar pa brgyad la mngon par zhen pa yin/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la mngon par zhen pa yin/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ mngon par shes pa rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ ting nge 'dzin rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la mngon par zhen pa yin/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi la mngon par zhen pa yin/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la mngon par zhen pa yin/ byams pa chen po la mngon par zhen pa yin/ snying rje chen po la mngon par zhen pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad la mngon par zhen pa yin/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la mngon par zhen pa yin/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la mngon par zhen pa yin/ phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la mngon par zhen pa yin/ dgra bcom pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ rang byang chub la mngon par zhen pa yin/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la mngon par zhen pa yin te/ de'i phyir

na byis pa zhes bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi slob cing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du mi 'byung ba lags sam/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi slob pa yin/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du mi 'byung ba yin/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi slob pa lags/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du mi 'byung ba lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ thabs mi mkhas pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ nang stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ phyi stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ phyi nang stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ chen po stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ don dam pa stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ thog ma dang tha ma

med pa stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ dngos po med pa stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ yang dag par spong ba rnams la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ dbang po rnams la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ stobs rnams la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ bsam gtan rnams la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ tshad med pa rnams la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ rnam par thar pa brgyad la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ mngon par shes pa rnams la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ ting nge 'dzin rnams la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi

la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ snying rje chen po la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ thams cad shes pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen pas/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi slob pa yin/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du mi 'byung ba yin no/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta lags na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnam pa gang gis slob par 'gyur ba lags/ ji ltar bslabs na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de mi dmigs/ yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis 'byung ba yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa de mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/

/sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ nang stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/ nang stong pa nyid de mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ phyi stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/ phyi stong pa nyid/ de mi dmigs shing yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ phyi nang stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/ phyi nang stong pa nyid de mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid de mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ chen po stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/ chen po stong pa nyid de mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/

spyod pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu po de dag mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi la spyod pa'i tshe/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi po de dag mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la spyod pa'i tshe/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi po de dag mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ snying rje chen po la spyod pa'i tshe/ snying rje chen po de mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la spyod pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa de dag mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/

pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / phyi stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / chen po stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar shes par bya'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ le'u drug go/ //de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram/ zhes mchis na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la/ ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ /bcom ldan 'das la la zhig la 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing /

rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ /bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ /bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ /bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ /bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ /bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ nang stong pa nyid la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur

bstan par bgyi/ /bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ snying rje chen po la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ /bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram/ zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rab 'byor de lta bas na/ de khyod nyid la dris/ khyod kyis ji ltar bzod pa de ltar lung ston cig /rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ gzugs kyang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ tshor ba yang gzhan la/ sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ 'du shes kyang gzhan la/ sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ 'du byed kyang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ rnam par shes
